proposed_widenings.name: modify_roll_numeric.attackKindFilter = spell_attack_only
proposed_widenings.justification: The surface can bonus attack rolls generally, or weapon attacks via weaponFilter, but it cannot scope a bonus to spell attack rolls only.
proposed_widenings.evidence: While holding it, you have a +2 bonus to spell attack rolls.

proposed_widenings.name: shared charge-pool spend for non-spell magic-item activations
proposed_widenings.justification: The item's spellcasting half can spend from a charge pool via grant_spell_access.mode.charge_cast, but Tree Form is a non-spell activation that also spends 1 charge from that same pool. The current surface has no honest way to express that shared-pool spend without duplicating the pool across composite parts.
proposed_widenings.evidence: This staff has 6 charges ... You can take a Magic action ... and expend 1 charge to transform the staff into a healthy tree.

proposed_widenings.name: ActivationPhase attachment target for item/object
proposed_widenings.justification: alter_item_kind exists, but activation attachments can currently target only self, target, area, or mark. Tree Form changes the staff itself, not the wielder or a creature.
proposed_widenings.evidence: transform the staff into a healthy tree

proposed_widenings.name: ItemDestructionPolicy.last_charge_roll_nonmagical
proposed_widenings.justification: The current destruction surface can destroy the item or exhaust it permanently, but not strip its magical properties while leaving behind a mundane item.
proposed_widenings.evidence: If you expend the last charge, roll 1d20. On a 1, the staff loses its properties and becomes a nonmagical Quarterstaff.

notes: No content files authored. The existing magic_item/composite family is the right top-level fit, but the current surface cannot encode the spell-attack-only bonus, shared non-spell charge spending for Tree Form, item-targeted transformation, and last-charge depowering honestly.
